questions.q: Which folder is the Installation Backlog report placed in, and why?
options: Sales Reports, because Opportunities feed it
Operations Reports, because it's Marcus Webb's Service team that works installation backlog
Customer Success Reports, because installations lead to service contracts
No folder -- it stays in the default Unfiled Public Reports folder
questions.explain: Operations Reports is shared to the Service Profile, matching who actually owns and works Installation Project records day to day.

questions.q: What does the Installation Backlog report filter OUT?
options: Installation Projects with a blank Site Address
Installation Projects where Install_Status__c equals "Complete"
Installation Projects created more than a year ago
Installation Projects not owned by Marcus Webb directly
questions.explain: The filter excludes Install_Status__c = "Complete", so the report only shows work that's still open -- the definition of a backlog.

questions.q: What two conditions does the Service Contract Renewals Coming Due report filter on?
options: Service Tier equals Premium, or Annual Value over $10,000
Renewal_Status__c equals "At Risk", or Contract End Date within the next 90 days
Account Record Type equals Hotel & Hospitality
Contract Start Date is blank
questions.explain: The OR filter surfaces anything already flagged At Risk plus anything approaching its end date, so Angela Wu can work renewals proactively.

questions.q: Why does the Cascade Executive Dashboard run as Monica Reyes instead of "run as logged-in user"?
options: Dashboards can only run as the System Administrator
Running as Monica Reyes guarantees the dashboard always shows the full picture her role hierarchy position entitles her to see, regardless of who's viewing it
It's required whenever a dashboard includes more than two components
Monica Reyes is the only user with a Sales Manager profile
questions.explain: Because Private OWD plus the Lesson 11 role hierarchy means Monica sees every record beneath her, a fixed running user guarantees consistent, complete results.

questions.q: What does the Pipeline by Stage report group by, and what does it summarize?
options: Groups by Account Record Type, summarizes Number of Kitchen Locations
Groups by Opportunity Owner, summarizes Discount Percent
Groups by Stage, summarizing the Sum of Amount and record count
Groups by Lead Source, summarizing Estimated Locations
questions.explain: Pipeline by Stage groups Opportunities by Stage and summarizes Sum of Amount plus record count, answering how much is sitting in each stage.
